comments.body: Just as a note here, to pull quest #3 (From London, disc Dodo), if you have already discovered and have hide completed quests on, it will fail to show. Even though it is a new quest and different story, it will count as "completed" in regards to the oxford skill.

comments.author: JoLeNe
comments.body: You don't need to lose the discovery card, it's a different quest altogether (with event type dialog). I tried (obviously unsuccessfully) to pull this quest with the hide quests thesis on and couldn't do it. Removed the oxford skill and the quest showed up right away. (I still had the Dodo card from previous quests). Just thought I'd mention it in case anyone was running this college skill and burning qmps hehe.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Understood. Let's just say it's my preference to lose discovery cards when I'm looking for a specific quest in European capitals like London, with the Oxford skill active that hides previously discovered quests; it cuts down the potential quest pool substantially, and so long as I don't reacquire those lost discovery cards, I can share the job quests/pre-quests with anybody who needs them indefinitely.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
Cost is 40 mil to change into without job card. If you've previously gotten this job before and want to get the card again, the quest to it is called "Investigating unknown lands" from London. Your need R13 Rec, R15 Arch, and Chinese language.

- Speak to Adventuer GM in London
- Read Arch book at the archives in Hangzhou 3 times (requires Chinese language)
- Use Rec skill at entrance in Xanadu

This is a hard quest to pull however (I burned 30 QMPs even with having the language and meeting the requirements) so it's up to you if it's worth using that many QMPs or flat out pay the 40 mil.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: There's a fleet that has the potential to drop the job card for this profession using the Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers. It's a Portuguese NPC fleet called "Juan de Gallai" (the name is G.T. from the Japanese wiki, actual name may vary on Maris). He's usually seen sailing between Lisbon and Casablanca, and sometimes around Porto. This is something to look into if you dont have the skills, or dont wish to go through the infamous Xanadu chain quest to unlock this job.
